# Offline synthetic imagery fixture

`synthetic-grid-z13.png` is original checker/contour artwork generated by `scripts/generate_commercial_fixtures.py`, under the repository MIT license. It contains no copied geographic or satellite imagery. Its companion JSON defines a Web Mercator test tile near Hamilton, Ontario; that registration is a test coordinate, not an observation.

`frontend/scripts/cesium-terrain-qa.mjs` serves it through loopback WMTS and the real Rust authentication/cache/composition pipeline. Public tile downloads are disabled. The generated `terrain/synthetic-n43.dt0` exercises terrain sampling and view transitions; it is not real topography. Optional local fixture overrides must carry their own permission/provenance.

The pixel gate counts the green diagnostic pattern to reject unpainted frames. Native terrain top-mesh and off-seam ray checks retain their 3 m display tolerance; the fixture cannot certify physical survey accuracy. EOX noncommercial imagery has been removed.
